description: Nothing. The webview calls this app's own commands, which are not ACL-gated, and the three Tauri plugins here are used from Rust only — so a permission for any of them would be a door the webview could walk through on a page that renders agent output. `pnpm nativecheck` pins this list empty and pins the plugin prefixes out of it. `main` is the window, and every account's webview is a child of it, so this one entry covers all of them.
